Future: VR math worlds, endless innovation."},"reasoning_summary":"Responses embody a blunt, chill 30yo DC man (low agreeableness/neuroticism/conscientiousness) loving math (fav subject) despite low education; casual self-taught style, family/job refs, openness to AI/innovation; hobbies/life integrated naturally."}
